subject: general
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). D is sitting second to the left of B. Exactly two people are sitting between B and A when counted from the right B. G is sitting to the immediate left of A. F is not an immediate neighbour of C. What is the position of G with respect to D?
solution: Given: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. D is sitting second to the left of B. Exactly two people are sitting between B and A when counted from the right. G is sitting to the immediate left of A. F is not an immediate neighbour of C.
